ns2:course.label: Stem Cell Basics & Application
ns2:course.description: In this introductory course, a survey of stem cell research is presented and discussed. Topics include Reproductive and Developmental Biology and Physiology of both adult- and embryo-derived stem cells, and their application to Regenerative Medicine. Each student as part of a group will identify research articles relative to each focus area and lead the discussion of the article for the whole class.
